seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Aliso Viejo, California for 2026: the free All Is Bright tree lighting with Santa and train rides, dates checked on the host site.
lede: Aliso Viejo's big Christmas night is the city's free All Is Bright tree lighting at Town Center, with Santa, train rides and ornament making.
celebrates: The City of Aliso Viejo hosts All Is Bright Holiday Celebration and Tree Lighting Ceremony at Aliso Viejo Town Center, and its own listing calls it a free community event for all ages. The evening centers on lighting a 24-foot holiday tree and adds Santa visits, face painting, ornament making, photo opportunities, train rides, live performances, an aerial show and a little magical snowfall. The city's recreation staff also run youth holiday programs listed on the city calendar, and the Aliso Viejo Community Association holds a members-only Sunday with Santa.
lastyear: The city's event calendar lists the 2025 All Is Bright Holiday Celebration and Tree Lighting Ceremony on Thursday, December 4, 2025, from 5 to 8 pm at Aliso Viejo Town Center. For 2026 the celebration returns on Thursday, December 3, 2026, in the same 5 to 8 pm time slot at the same location, according to the city's ticket page and news item.
facts: All Is Bright is a city-run event listed on Eventbrite by the City of Aliso Viejo, and the city's own news item says Santa lights the tree at the Town Center. The Aliso Viejo Community Association's separate Sunday with Santa on December 6, 2026 is for members and residents only, with address checks at the door, and it is sold out.
trains: All Is Bright lists train rides as part of the free tree lighting night at Town Center, so Aliso Viejo has a Christmas train ride of its own on December 3. For a rail museum visit, the Fullerton Train Museum at the Fullerton station is free and open on the first and third Saturdays, and the Southern California Railway Museum in Perris has free admission with weekend train and trolley rides, according to Rally's museum pages.

faq: How does Aliso Viejo celebrate Christmas?

The city holds All Is Bright Holiday Celebration and Tree Lighting Ceremony at Aliso Viejo Town Center each December, with a 24-foot tree, Santa, train rides, ornament making, face painting, performances and snowfall. The Aliso Viejo Community Association also holds a members-only Sunday with Santa.
Is there a free Christmas event in Aliso Viejo?
Yes. The City of Aliso Viejo lists All Is Bright Holiday Celebration and Tree Lighting Ceremony as a free community event for all ages.
Where can kids meet Santa in Aliso Viejo?
Santa visits are part of All Is Bright at Aliso Viejo Town Center on December 3, 2026. The Community Association's Sunday with Santa is limited to members and residents and is sold out.
Is there a Christmas train ride in Aliso Viejo?
The city lists train rides at the All Is Bright celebration on December 3, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm at Town Center.
When is the Aliso Viejo tree lighting in 2026?
Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm at Aliso Viejo Town Center on Pacific Park Drive.
